entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Secluded haven of the queen of the fae on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, a wellspring of blue and black mana.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Current queen of the fae, who glamers the glen.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Former eternally-blooming queen of the fae whose protective magic kept Glen Elendra unchanged by the Great Aurora.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event that changed Lorwyn but not Glen Elendra.

events.summary: Oona fell and Maralen assumed control as queen of the fae; the palace expanded to fit her.
events.quote: After her fall, Maralen assumed control as the queen of the plane's fae

relations.quote: The current reigning queen is Maralen .
Glen Elendra was occupied by the eternally-blooming queen Oona .
